warm.scope: 2 trials of600 ticks per A-before/B/A-after stage and selected idle/heavy case. Every complete tick included. Physical work/convergence counters checked; this does not replace full body/force trajectory qualification or the52-case gates.

light.repetition_policy: Equal per-process counts in A-before/B/A-after; all first-use ticks included at equal weight. Pooled controls have twice the candidate sample count.
light.scope: One full tick per independent physical restore. A-before / B / A-after per scenario. All CPU/GPU work and correction included; restore, validation and post-tick observation excluded. Unprofiled comparison with recorded GPU admission; no profiler timings or automatic acceptance.

scope: Unprofiled complete ticks including CPU, GPU, transfers, waits, correction and publication. Equal600 ticks per run, two runs per stage per scenario; no restore cost. Both continuous trajectories and cold light scenarios are preserved. This report does not automatically qualify retention.
conclusion: No verified warm application improvement. Heavy mean between controls; peak and semantic-frame spread retained. Full52/policy qualification remains open.
